skills.name: blog-posts
skills.description: Author, format, and embed content in Bluefin blog posts under blog/. Use when editing a blog post, converting a social post to blog format, embedding Bluesky posts, adding images, or fixing MDX minifier paragraph errors.

triggers: editing a blog post, converting a social post to blog format, embedding Bluesky posts, adding images, or fixing MDX minifier paragraph errors

triggers: adding or updating logos, navbar branding, press kit graphics, or styling components with brand accent colors

skills.name: cloudflare-workers

triggers: adding, changing, or debugging a Worker, a wrangler config, or a Workers KV binding

triggers: adding or changing components under src/components/, testing correctness rules, or verifying render output

triggers: editing a factory panel title or summary, adding a lane or image to the dashboard, touching countme adoption numbers, or styling an ECharts chart in src/components/factory/

triggers: a card shows stale or missing version data, when adding a card for a new image stream, when changing card layout, or when generate-card-images skips a slug

triggers: a pull request cannot enter the merge queue, when merging stacked pull requests, or when verifying a live change across cache boundaries
